Neutropenic colitis is a life-threatening condition usually seen in patients who are severely myelosuppressed.

Although the exact pathogenesis is not completely understood, severe neutropenia conjugated with intestinal mucosal injury and the weakened immune system appear to be the denominator for neutropenic enterocolitis.
An increased incidence of neutropenic colitis cases came as a consequence of the extensive use of chemotherapeutic agents.
